verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss is a SaaS CRM, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking controls. The 'performance details' reporting describes CRM analytics, not product telemetry, and is not relevant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
